question: What may be given to śūdras and others according to Vedic knowledge?
premises: The recipients include śūdras and others
Someone may give something to them
That gift is accomplished through Vedic knowledge
inference: One may give to śūdras and others what has been accomplished through Vedic knowledge.
plain_english: And whoever should give to śūdras and others what has been accomplished through Vedic knowledge.
